Bihar MLC Row:bihar vidhan parishad ke aath navnirvachit sadasyon ne pad aur gopniyta ki shapath li...lekin is shapath grahan samaroh ke sath hi do nirdaliy MLC ki sadasyata ko lekar siyasi sangram ek bar phir tej ho gaya... tirhut snatak sit se banshidhar brajvasi aur saran shikshak sit se rahul raj ki sadasyata par tejasvi yadav ne saval uthae hain... tejasvi ne ab is mamle men haeekort jane ka ailan kiya hai... to satta paksh ne ise vipaksh ki rajnitik bechaini karar diya hai...
